description_text: Proposed procurement for NSN 5999011907720 SHIELDING GASKET,EL: Line 0001 Qty 84 UI EA Deliver To: By: 0091 DAYS ADO This Solicitation may result in an Automated IDC (Indefinite Delivery Contract).
